verdict.rationale: Stable documents its own guided USPS Form 1583 onboarding flow. It can submit 1583 information programmatically, generate a USPS1583 Shared Session, and produce a signature packet with a link to sign the form. CMRA locations are noted as requiring Form 1583, document uploads and a signature packet, but the evidence covers only the signing step, not notarization or ID guidance. The 'prefilled forms' claim belongs to the registered-agent product and does not transfer to the 1583 story. Missing for 10: explicit online notarization, documented ID requirement guidance, pre-filled 1583 forms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the founder-facing guided experience.
